verdict: ОТБОР МОНЕТ НЕ СПАСАЕТ: кэрри с базисом убыточен при любом отборе — по funding -1.9%/год, по ликвидности -4.2%, все 68 равным весом -4.6%.
question: is the carry-with-basis loss caused by SELECTING coins by funding rate?

top10_by_funding.construction: p3b: rank by past 30d avg funding, take top 10

top10_by_liquidity.construction: same method, but rank by past 30d spot turnover, take top 10

bottom10_illiquid.construction: same method, but rank by liquidity ASCENDING (the illiquid end)

all_equal_weight.construction: no selection: equal weight the whole universe

interpretation: selection is not the defect: carry with basis is unprofitable under every selection tried.
limitations: Basis is measured close-to-close on daily bars; intraday path not modelled.
Liquidity is measured on SPOT turnover, not perp depth, which is the market that would actually be traded.
Costs charged only on rebalance days.
No forward/out-of-sample claim: all four arms are historical descriptions of the same period.
